title: Memory Leak in Notification Service Causes OOM Kills
description: A deployment introduced a memory leak in notification-service where WebSocket connections are not properly closed on client disconnect. Memory grows unbounded until container OOM kill at ~2GB.
initial_symptoms: Notification service pods restarting every 10-15 minutes

evidence_catalog.summary: Notification service memory shows sawtooth pattern: grows from 200MB to 2GB over 10min, then drops to 200MB (restart)
evidence_catalog.query_reference: SELECT max(container_memory_bytes) FROM container_metrics WHERE service='notification-service'
evidence_catalog.synthetic_fixture_note: Phase 1/2 will generate container memory metrics with sawtooth pattern

evidence_catalog.summary: Kubernetes events show OOMKilled for notification-service pods every 10-15 minutes
evidence_catalog.query_reference: SELECT * FROM k8s_events WHERE reason='OOMKilled' AND involved_object='notification-service'
evidence_catalog.synthetic_fixture_note: Phase 1/2 will generate K8s OOMKilled events

evidence_catalog.summary: Deployment deploy-792 rolled out notification-service v3.2.1 with new WebSocket handler
Commit added WebSocket connection tracking but forgot to remove from map on disconnect
evidence_catalog.synthetic_fixture_note: Phase 1/2 will create commit diff showing missing cleanup

evidence_catalog.summary: Active WebSocket connections metric shows steady increase (never decreases on disconnect)
evidence_catalog.query_reference: SELECT websocket_active_connections FROM service_metrics WHERE service='notification-service'
evidence_catalog.synthetic_fixture_note: Phase 1/2 will generate WebSocket connection metrics

evidence_catalog.synthetic_fixture_note: Phase 1/2 will simulate heap dump analysis result

changes.summary: Deployed notification-service v3.2.1 with WebSocket connection leak

causal_chain.from_description: Deployment v3.2.1 introduced WebSocket connection leak
causal_chain.to_description: WebSocket connections added to map on connect but never removed on disconnect

causal_chain.from_description: Stale connections accumulate in memory (50k+ entries)
causal_chain.to_description: Memory grows linearly until OOM kill at 2GB limit
WebSocket clients disconnected; notification delivery interrupted

contributing_factors: No memory leak detection in CI

misleading_or_confounding_signals: GC logs show frequent collections (symptom, not cause)
Other services on same node unaffected (isolated to this service)

required_checks.description: Analyze memory growth pattern for sawtooth
Check WebSocket connection count never decreases
Review WebSocket handler for cleanup on disconnect
required_checks.expected_outcome: Missing removal from connections map in onDisconnect

remediation_guidance.suggestion: Add connection cleanup in WebSocket onDisconnect handler; add connection timeout/cleanup job
test_plan: Add unit test for WebSocket disconnect cleanup
